phoneNumber.description: This is the phone number that the message is associated with.

type.description: This is the type of the message. "transcript" is sent as transcriber outputs partial or final transcript.

timestamp.description: This is the timestamp of the message.

artifact.description:
This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.

This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.

assistant.description: This is the assistant that the message is associated with.

customer.description: This is the customer that the message is associated with.

call.description: This is the call that the message is associated with.

role.description: This is the role for which the transcript is for.

transcriptType.description: This is the type of the transcript.

isFiltered.description: Indicates if the transcript was filtered for security reasons.

detectedThreats.description: List of detected security threats if the transcript was filtered.

originalTranscript.description: The original transcript before filtering (only included if content was filtered).
